summary: ObservaNexus license renewal + 30 additional seats request (Telemetry & Observability team)
description:
Issue summary:
Request to renew our annual ObservaNexus SaaS contract and purchase 30 additional user seats for the Telemetry & Observability team. Current license expires 2026-03-31. Impact: without renewal we risk losing retention of logs/metrics and saved dashboards used by on-call and SRE teams.

Business justification:
- Team growth: new hires and consolidation of dashboards has exceeded current seat count.
- Operational risk: several runbooks depend on ObservaNexus alerts and dashboards.
- Cost efficiency: vendor quoted a 10% multi-year discount if we commit to 12 months now.

Requested items:
- 30 additional ObservaNexus Standard seats (user seats with dashboard access).
- 12-month renewal for existing 70-seat subscription (counts roll up to 100 seats).
- SCIM + SSO provisioning enabled; audit log retention set to 13 months.

Vendor details and constraints:
- Vendor: ObservaNexus Inc.
- Primary contact: Jordan Park (jordan.park@observanexus.example)
- Quote ref: ONX-QUOTE-2026-03-02-724
- Licensing model: per-seat, annual term, auto-renew off.
- Data residency: vendor can host EU data in eu-west but default is us-east; need confirmation for EU dashboards used by EU product teams.

Budget and approvals:
- Budget code: FIN-BUD-2026-Q1-OBS
- Estimated annual spend: $24,600 (quote line items attached).
- Approval path requested: Manager -> Finance -> Security -> Legal -> Procurement PO.

Timeline:
- Target PO issuance by 2026-03-20 to avoid service interruption on 2026-03-31.

Attachments referenced:
- GDrive: ObservaNexus_quote_March2026.pdf
- GDrive: Observability_seat_audit_2026-03-05.xlsx

Notes: Please confirm whether Legal needs the full vendor Master Services Agreement (MSA) uploaded to ContractSafe or if signature can be via procurement portal.
requested_items: 12-month renewal for existing 70 seats -> total 100 seats
billing_terms: Net 30; annual prepay preferred for discount
